final: SELECT AVG(g.apt) AS avg_pt, AVG(g.adiff) AS avg_diff FROM (SELECT ID, AVG(PT) AS apt, AVG(TAT - TAT2) AS adiff FROM Laboratory WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE "U-PRO" = '-' AND ID IS NOT NULL) AND ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE RA = '-' AND ID IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY ID) g
